mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.2%, accompanied by rising payroll employment (PAYEMS), indicates a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105, signaling strengthening supply chains, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening supply chain periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 700000, indicating robust consumer spending, drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5%, signaling rising inflation concerns, lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising inflation concern periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A stagnant unemployment rate (UNRATE) between 3.5% and 4.0%, coupled with slowing payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100000, indicates a labor market inflection point, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.012 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% annually, regardless of other conditions, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong GDP growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
